name: looker-migration
description: Migrate Looker dashboards/Looks into Hex. This coding agent discovers content over the Looker REST API, translates LookML + Looker's generated SQL, and writes a migration brief; Hex's notebook agent builds a generative app on gated SQL cells; then it's verified with a SQL-fidelity gate (numeric parity against Looker's own values) and a visual-QA loop.
